context_requirements: Expression of human topoisomerase II alpha (TOP2A), the closest human homologue of bacterial DNA gyrase
Active DNA replication or proliferation, since TOP2A is required for replication and is low in quiescent cells
Intact DNA damage response signaling (ATM/ATR, p53) for transcriptional readout
Sufficient intracellular drug exposure at 10 micromolar; efflux or poor permeability may blunt response
falsifiers: No change in TOP2A, CDKN1A, or GADD45A at 6 or 24 h in any of the nine lines
No decrease in proliferation or G2/M markers (CCNB1, CDK1, AURKA/B, BIRC5) at 24 h
A response pattern indistinguishable from vehicle across all lines
Strong interferon or unfolded protein response without DNA damage response genes

evidence.supports: Simocyclinone D8, a bacterial DNA gyrase inhibitor, inhibits human topoisomerase II and decreases proliferation of MCF-7 breast cancer cells, supporting TOP2A as a human target and antiproliferative readout.
